content:
In any year, there are at most 53 Sundays. If \(x\) months have five Sundays, the other \(12-x\) months have at least four Sundays, so

\[
48+x \le 53 \implies x \le 5.
\]

This is attainable, for example in a common year starting on Sunday, where Jan, Apr, Jul, Oct, and Dec each have five Sundays.

\[
\boxed{5}
\]
